entities.name: Seven

entities.name: Wrenn
entities.description: A dryad planeswalker who merged with Seven as her symbiotic host.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker, compleated by Phyrexia in this account, who killed Seven.

entities.name: Ulvenwald
